result.summary: Found 1 major issue: duplicated restaurant cards in the 'Fastest near you' carousel.

issues.description: Two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' cards appear side-by-side in the 'Fastest near you' carousel, with the same image, 15-25 min delivery time, name, and €0.90 delivery fee and no distinguishing information such as a different location.
issues.suggestion: Deduplicate the restaurant feed, or if these are different locations, add a distinguishing label such as address/distance to each card and use their correct images.
